The Rise of Tik Tok

By: Julian Sun | Delivery

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
Tik-Tok: Gen-Z's social media platform of choice

Unique Selling Point:
We look at the phenomenal rise of the social media platform TikTok to reveal why it's so popular with Generation Z.

Summary:
We look at the social media app Tik Tok - which is the newest social media app taking the world & South Africa by storm. This app, created in China by a company called Byte-Size allows users to create short-form videos. It’s incredibly popular and has amassed over 800 millions globally and around 6 million in South Africa. It made big news over the weekend when its young user base was blamed for affecting Donald Trump’s rally in Tulsa, Oklahoma.

It was the biggest social media sensation of 2019 and is continuing into the youth market in 2020.

We’d look at the rise of the app’s popularity, understand why how and why it has become so popular. A lot of it has to do with its powerful AI Algorithm that shapes the content every person views.

We would also look at the type of content being generated by Tik Tok and meet some of the South African content creators, some of whom have millions of followers.

We’d also look at the cybercrime aspect of the app when it comes to protecting children,

Press Release:


The Uptake in Tik Tok
South African media experts have called the Tik Tok the social media sensation of 2019 and observe as the app continues its meteoric rise across the world. Used for creating, sharing and discovering short videos, the app is gaining popularity among Generation Z an outlet to express themselves in an unvarnished way. Carte Blanche examines how Tik Tok has engineered stickability into the promotion of content creators’ bite-sized clips and set socially aware teenagers up as a force to be reckoned with.
Producer: Julian Sun | Presenter: Claire Mawisa

Script:


Opening Link: Claire shoots a Tik Tok Video, laughs and then turns to camera:

Claire: I’ve just uploaded my first video to Tik-Tok, the fastest growing social media app in the world with over 800 million users. So what is it about it that makes it so addictive and popular?

V/O: We’re familiar with Facebook, Twitter, Instagram & Snapchat but now there’s a new kid on the block. Since its release, Tik Tok has amassed hundreds of millions of active users fed a daily diet of lip-synching, dancing, hair & cooking tutorials, magic, comedy & social commentary.

A powerful algorithm curates each person’s feed ensuring the content they view is exactly what they want. World Wide Worx’s Arthur Goldstuck explains how it works



Arthur on the Tik Tok Algorithm

CLAIRE: The majority of Tik-Tok users are between the ages of 10-24, a new group that marketers have dubbed as Gen-Z. So how does this new generation differ from the millenials that preceded them?

V/O: Bronwyn Williams of Flux Trends provides insight into those born after 1995.

Bronwyn on Gen-Z and why they love Tik Tok so much

V/O: Owned by the Chinese company ByteDance Tik Tok is the most downloaded app of 2020, with massive followings in China, India & the United States. This has spawned a new generation of content creators who go to great lengths to create videos for their millions of followers

Forbes Magazine’s Kate Talbot explains their power & influence

Kate on the biggest American Tik Tok influencers




V/O: Here in South Africa, the popularity of Tik Tok has exploded and created our own home-grown stars. The most popular is Wian magic with a staggering 9.4 million followers

Wian Magic Trick intro

Wian describes his phenomenal success of Tik Tok and the thought that goes into the content he creates

V/O: Another popular content creator is Pretoria’s Witney 8 with close to 1 million followers from all over the world

V/O: Tik Tok may seem fun and light-hearted but like all social media platforms, could lead to cyberbullying, something Witney has experienced.

Witney on cyberbullying


V/O: The good side of Tik Tok is that content creators are able to act as role models to their fans.

But on the darker side, many users are teenagers and vulnerable to sexual predators. Has the platform done enough to protect them?

Arthur on safeguards

Nikki Bush wrote a book about tech-savvy parenting.
Nikki on teaching children how to protect themselves online

V/O: Despite these concerns, Tik Tok’s popularity amongst the youth is undiminished and seen as a force for good by many influencers.

Local creator Kelly KiKx is a prime example.

Kelly on being socially aware and active on Tik Tok

V/O: What’s clear is that the snackable content of Tik Tok is being created by a new generation of socially aware and politically active teenagers.

So much so that last month, hundreds of thousands of tik tok users came together to troll US President Donald Trump making world headlines.




Kate on the trolling of Trump

V/O: Tik Tok continues to grow in popularity, adding 12 million new visitors in March alone. But is this growth sustainable and what does the future hold?

Kate Closing Comment
PROMO: Last month hundreds of thousands of Tik Tok users trolled the President of the United States to the amusement of the world!
What’s behind the staggering power & popularity of Tik Tok?

Promo 2: Tik Tok is the social media platform of choice for teenagers of today, turning content creators into genuine Gen-Z celebrities. We meet some of South Africa’s biggest Tik Tok stars.
